workflows.content: Represent a talk by normalising presentation inputs, materialising or reusing the presentation concept, linking the presenter, and verifying the requested talk representation profile.
workflows.description: Canonical durable workflow for representing talks and presentations in Vontology from structured meeting and speaker inputs.
workflow_notes: Capability-gap note: this workflow depends on Python durable actions because current VWL/runtime primitives cannot yet express a reusable, deterministic representation-materialisation primitive for concept creation/update plus postcondition verification. Workflow #V#talk_representation_workflow should migrate fully into VWL once the runtime can declaratively express stable concept reuse, singleton text upserts, relationship writes, and verification against required representation predicates.
